paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Drafter / Junior Designer role listed on SEEK through Titan Recruitment (job 95251750). The focus on AutoCAD civil drawings for infrastructure projects matches the path I am building after finishing my Advanced Diploma.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). My CAD production so far is from study rather than commercial drafting.
From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and field engineer, reviewing drawings, doing inspections and keeping site and material records.

I live in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to the Gold Coast for this junior drafting role.
I have attached my resume and cover letter and would welcome the chance to discuss the role.
